author: Bobby Grayson
description:
No Lean files were touched by wf7/locals: nothing was added to SysProps.lean, Fair.lean or AssocList.lean, and no example file changed. The four new ok fixtures carry "lean: check" and compile against the existing library only. Siblings have nothing to reuse or clash with on the Lean side.

What a sibling DOES need to know is the new shape the translator can now emit into a generated file, because a hand-written example that proves things about such a module will see it:

  * Zero or more "def <module>_<function> (x : T) .. : R := ..." definitions between the pid constants and "def sig". They are ordinary total Lean definitions over the file's own inductives, and "beh" applies them.
  * When some helper is recursive in a way Lean does not see as structural, one extra definition ahead of them:
        def localFuel : Nat := 64
    and that helper takes a leading "(fuel : Nat)", returning the default value of its result type at fuel 0. A proof about such a module is a proof about the fuel-limited function, not about the Elixir one for inputs deeper than 64; the generated file says so in a doc comment. If an example needs the unbounded function it should state its own Lean definition and prove the generated one agrees up to the depth it cares about.
title: No generic Lean lemmas added by wf7/locals; what the new generated shape looks like
